name: Maezono Mizuki
source:
Second grader, she's the Drama Club director. Strongly aiming to compete with the "Takarazuka Revue" (a famous Japanese all-female musical theater troupe), puts much effort in her ambitions and strongly pretends the same from the others, she's somewhat stifling.

[From [url=http://www.4gamer.net/games/140/G014016/20120207045/]4Gamer.net[/url]]
